[[File:NStower.png|thumb|right|180px|A Nightsister tower]]A '''Nightsister Tower''' was a tall structure the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] would build on their homeworld of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was a large lighted tower made of dathomirian wood, sedimentary ore and siliclastic ore.

At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], schematics to produce such towers could be bought from a vendor of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]&mdash;eccentric customers from other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] would sometimes use these structures as exotic city decorations.
